instruction: Configure VS Code to disable automatic type acquisition for JavaScript projects.

metadata.explanation: Task requires modifying VS Code settings to disable automatic type acquisition for JavaScript/TypeScript projects. Uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify the setting is correctly added to settings.json.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to disable automatic type acquisition

The typescript.disableAutomaticTypeAcquisition setting is correct - VS Code uses TypeScript language service for JavaScript intellisense, so this setting affects both TypeScript and JavaScript projects
Getter logic correctly retrieves the VS Code settings.json file from the VM
Metric logic correctly extracts expected values from the rules dictionary (expected parameter receives rules dict directly from get_rule)
Metric correctly checks that the setting exists in settings.json with the correct boolean value (true)
Complete coverage - the single instruction requirement is fully verified
No postconfig needed - settings.json is a persistent file accessible after task completion
Expected value semantically correct - true disables the feature as required
